_comment: This file lists the kinds of file an FM Towns project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project has floppy disks, CDs, or both; the machine also starts with neither, to its own menu or prompt. The order of the files in a slot is the order the Next Floppy Disk and Next CD buttons change them in: the first floppy is in drive 1 and the first CD in the drive at power on.
